title: Extremely Drunk Shoplifter Acts Tough With Cops, Ends Badly
description:
On June 24th, 2022, officers responded to a disturbance. An intoxicated man was behaving erratically and refusing to cooperate with the store’s employees officers had to make the man sit on one of the shopping carts to remove him from the store. The man was taken to the hospital for treatment. The male was charged with shoplifting. Youtube thinks you’ll love the video on screen.
